title: Cloud files — what you will see and when

steps.headline: UI-6 · Browse without downloading or answering a prompt.
steps.changed: When you open Projects, online-only files show a small cloud icon. Local files keep normal previews.
steps.notice: No folder permission. Browsing never downloads content just for previews, descriptions or counts.
steps.risk: Fake file availability; no backend protection yet. Windows behavior is unverified.

steps.headline: UI-7 · Download only the file you chose to open.
steps.changed: Replaces old UI-1: clicking a file explains its source and asks Download and open / Not now.
steps.notice: OneDrive is named only when known. No saved grant; Not now returns to browsing.
steps.risk: Simulated operation; no real download protection or provider detection yet.

steps.headline: UI-8 · A compact notice keeps the selected file in context.
steps.changed: Refines old UI-3: after approval, two lines name the file and explain that it will open here when ready.
steps.notice: Keep working elsewhere. Continuation belongs to the original action and must not steal focus from newer work.
steps.risk: Simulated wait only. Completion, focus preservation and concurrent operations remain unimplemented.

steps.path: Start a conversation needing online-only instructions
steps.headline: UI-9 · Ask inside the affected conversation, not Projects.
steps.changed: Replaces rejected UI-4. If startup needs instructions, one card lists the exact files and offers Download and continue / Not now.
steps.notice: This example needs CLAUDE.md and project-guidelines.md for one action. It does not approve a folder or silently omit required instructions.
steps.risk: An empty workbench conversation substitutes for real startup. The listed requirements are invented fixture facts; optional discovery is not a required-instructions contract.

steps.headline: UI-10 · Continue that conversation when its instructions are ready.
steps.changed: After approval, the card stays in the conversation and names the required files while waiting for OneDrive.
steps.notice: No percentage or stop-download promise. Other conversations remain usable; external programs get no new restrictions.
steps.risk: Waiting is simulated and never finishes. Real startup, deduplication, completion and Windows hydration remain unverified; no cancellation behavior was added.
